scope: Exact Fraction accounting/protocol replay only; not e-process validity, FDR/SupFDR, statistical power, Rust implementation, or source authenticity.

configuration.activation: predictable blocks of four candidates, staggered every five rounds
configuration.assignment: past-only allocation; each assignment occurs strictly after reserve creation; destination immutable
configuration.credit: partial credit permitted only after recipient activation

checks: source-only reserve derived from own evidence
assignment does not exceed unassigned token balance
credit does not exceed assigned remaining balance
nondecreasing scores at each atomic LookCommit
policy digest and event sequence integrity
incoming credit cannot fund a new reserve

interpretation: The replay validates the two-phase accounting state machine on deterministic exact-rational traces. It does not validate the statistical e-process assumptions or a production Rust implementation.
